applies_to: Belimo 2-way EPIV DN 15-50 Version 4 (EP..R2+(K)BAC) on Modbus RTU, per interface description edition 2025-09 / V4.2.
summary: Belimo's electronic pressure-independent valve measures flow with its own sensor and controls either position or flow. On Modbus RTU it takes a relative setpoint and override, and reports position, flow in l/s, gpm and a selectable unit, medium temperature, glycol and accumulated volume, plus fault flags and the min/max flow limits. 32-bit values are low word first.

addressing.note: Belimo prints each register twice: 'No.' counts from 1 and 'Address' from 0, and the documented value here is the No. column. Register No. 1 (setpoint) is wire address 0. Every value sits in one flat table, so holding-register reads (FC 3) and writes (FC 6/16) reach everything; FC 4 input-register reads of the same addresses also work.

source.title: Modbus interface description - 2-way EPIV, DN 15...50 (Version 4.2)
source.pages: General notes pp. 4-5; register overview pp. 6-7; register description pp. 8-14

notes: 32-bit values occupy two registers with the low word first (Belimo's worked example: No. 10 = 14551, No. 11 = 19 gives 19 x 65536 + 14551 = 1,259,735), so they are UINT32 with CDAB word order. Write a 32-bit pair with one FC 16 request covering only those two registers.
Values are unsigned unless Belimo marks them signed (**): the flow-body temperatures (No. 22/23) are signed two's complement and typed INT16.
The flow-meter serial-number pairs (No. 201/202, 203/204) are marked LowWord/HighWord in the register overview, so they are typed UINT32 low word first.
Unsupported registers read 65535. Writable registers from No. 101 up are persistent; don't write them cyclically.
Belimo notes that the HVAC application may clamp values inside the listed ranges depending on the valve size (see the product datasheet).
Unlike the air/water actuators, Setpoint source (No. 119) defaults to Analog on this valve: write 1 before bus setpoints take effect.

integration.summary: Set address and frame with Belimo Assistant 2, write Setpoint source No. 119 = 1 (Bus), choose Control mode No. 117, then write the setpoint to No. 1 (address 0) and poll flow (No. 8 or 10), position (No. 5) and faults (No. 105).
integration.enable: Configure Modbus address (1-247), baud and frame with Belimo Assistant 2, then write No. 119 = 1 so the valve follows the bus setpoint.
integration.watchdog: No. 110 sets the timeout (5-3600 s, default 120 s). If neither No. 1 nor No. 2 is written in that time, the valve performs the Bus fail action in No. 109 (default None) and bit 15 of No. 105 is set.
quirks: Register No. is 1-based; subtract 1 for the wire address.
Changing Control mode (No. 117) resets the device.
32-bit pairs are low word first and must be written with one FC 16 covering only that pair.
setup: Up to 32 nodes per segment without a repeater; terminate with 120 ohm.
gotchas: Out of the box the valve listens to the analog input, not the bus.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
